actual: The finalizer stopped after close-sync PR merge because cleanup verification saw stale origin/main and raised `branch is not merged into origin/main`, requiring manual fetch/sync and manual cleanup from the root checkout.
closure_requirements: Keep BUG JSON and GitHub Issue synchronized.

description: The finalizer stopped after close-sync PR merge because cleanup verification saw stale origin/main and raised `branch is not merged into origin/main`, requiring manual fetch/sync and manual cleanup from the root checkout.
expected: Before verifying or cleaning a source or close-sync branch after a PR merge, finalizer/cleanup should refresh origin/main (fetch/prune) or otherwise use the verified PR merge state, so stale local origin refs cannot produce a false unmerged-branch blocker.
non_goals: Do not restart production runtime services without explicit approval.
